caption: The image depicts an ornately decorated platter in a rectangular shape with rounded and slightly flared corners. The border of the platter features a detailed floral and foliage design, with various leaves, flowers, and vines rendered in a dark hue contrasting against lighter details, suggesting a monochromatic or possibly dark-on-light color scheme. In the central area of the platter, there is an oval-shaped frame containing a scenic illustration. Inside this scene, two human figures are depicted standing on either side of a large shield with decorative elements: the figure on the left is a woman draped in fabric, while the figure on the right is also a woman holding a cornucopia or basket overflowing with some kind of produce. Behind the shield is a horse's head, and the background consists of a hilly or mountainous landscape with a cloudy sky. Below the central image, within a bordered cartouche, is the inscription "NEW JERSEY." The overall composition is symmetric, with the rich border pattern surrounding the more detailed central imagery. The image appears to be a grayscale photograph of the platter, rendering the entire scene in shades of black, white, and gray.
title: Plate - "New Jersey Arms"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
